title: Guide - Finding Rest - Resting in silence

parts.style: warm, gentle late-night welcome, a soft smile in the voice, speaking slowly
parts.text: Welcome to Finding Rest. <short pause> This practice is called Resting in Silence. <short pause> I'll say a little, and then less. <short pause> Between my words there will be some quiet, and you don't have to fill it.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Settle where you are. <short pause> Let the surface beneath you take your weight. <short pause> Notice the sounds that are already here... something humming, something passing outside, your own soft breath. <short pause> None of them needs anything from you. <short pause> They can stay.

parts.style: gentle, a soft smile in the voice, illustrating
parts.text: Silence can feel strange at first. <short pause> When the noise stops, our thoughts sometimes get louder. <short pause> But think of two old friends on a porch at dusk. <short pause> They can sit for a long while without a word... <short pause> and neither one wonders if they are still loved.
Rest with God can be like that. <short pause> David knew it, even while others were working against him. <short pause> In Psalm sixty-two, verse five, he turns to his own soul and says these words.
My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him. <long pause>

parts.style: slow, reflective, letting the words sink in
parts.text: Wait thou only upon God. <short pause> Waiting is not performing. <short pause> You don't have to feel something special, or hear an answer. <short pause> You only have to be here, with the One who is already here.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Choose one small word to return to. <short pause> It might be Father... <short pause> or here... <short pause> or wait. <short pause> When a thought pulls you away, don't push against it. <short pause> Let it pass, and gently say your word again.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: We'll begin with just a few breaths of quiet. <short pause> Let your face be soft, and your hands be still. <short pause> I'll speak again in a moment. <short pause> Until then... <short pause> simply wait with Him.
That's enough. <short pause> However it went, it was enough. <short pause> If your mind was crowded, God was with you in the crowd. <short pause> If it was calm, He was with you in the calm.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: This time, the quiet will be a little longer. <short pause> There is nothing to achieve in it. <short pause> If your word comes to mind, say it once. <short pause> If it doesn't, you can rest without it. <short pause> You are allowed... to simply be held.

parts.style: slow, reflective, letting the words sink in
parts.text: Still here. <short pause> And He is still here. <short pause> My soul, wait thou only upon God. <short pause> You haven't had to explain yourself, or prove a thing... <short pause> and you have not been alone for one moment of it.

God of all quiet, <short pause> thank You that I can be with You without words. <short pause> Receive my silence as a prayer. <short pause> Receive my tiredness as trust. <short pause> And when I can no longer keep my attention on You, keep Yours on me. <short pause> Amen.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Now I'll leave you with one last space of quiet. <short pause> You don't need to wait for me after this. <short pause> If sleep comes while you are resting, let it come. <short pause> It is safe to drift away in His company.
Wait thou only upon God. <short pause> There is nothing more you need to say tonight. <short pause> Rest now.
